question: Which major work by Tsongkhapa sets out the stages of the path to awakening?

positions.answer: The Great Treatise on the Stages of the Path to Enlightenment (Lamrim Chenmo)
aliases: Great Treatise on the Stages of the Path
Great Exposition of the Stages of the Path

question: Which statement best describes the ultimate truth (emptiness)? Choose one.

choices.text: Emptiness is the mere absence of inherent existence, a non-affirming negation.
The ultimate is buddha-nature, empty of everything other than itself but not empty of its own nature.
The ultimate is freedom from all conceptual extremes, including existence, non-existence, both and neither.

sources.ref: Gorampa Sönam Senggé, Distinguishing the Views

notes: Not scored for accuracy. Choice labels are hidden from the model; the scorer reports which tradition's answer a model defaults to. Nyingma and Kagyu authors also hold views close to C or B; reviewers from those schools should refine this item before it leaves example status.
